DISCUSS: Honor Roll: Baugh, Montgomery and Lovett Collect SEC Weekly Awards After Ole Miss Rout
Jadan Baugh earned his first SEC Offensive Player of the Week award, while London Montgomery and Bryce Lovett received their first SEC weekly honors after Florida’s 52-28 win over No. 4 Ole Miss.
https://www.gatorbaitmedia.com/post/honor-roll-baugh-montgomery-and-lovett-collect-sec-weekly-awards-after-ole-miss-rout
By Brenden Martin. Read it on GatorBait, then talk about it here. One thread per story; GatorBot posts the link, people post the takes.
